meta.name: Ethiopia
meta.blurb: Seven frontiers around the mountain empire, every one of them a colony. Restore Aksum from the Nile to the Red Sea.
meta.pitch: a 1935 grand-strategy war map of Ethiopia
meta.capitalFalls: The government withdraws to Gore in the western highlands. The war goes on.
meta.capitalFreed: Addis Ababa is free again. The Emperor returns to the capital.
ranks: Beloved Ras, First Lord of the Realm

landmarks.desc: Reach Adulis, the lost port of Aksum on the Red Sea
Enter Meroë, the city of the kings of Kush, where an Aksumite king once raised his inscription

medalNames.ten: Order of the Star of Ethiopia
medalNames.week: Order of the Queen of Sheba

days.text: Melkam Addis Amet. Enkutatash: a new year on every front.
Adwa Day. The empire remembers the first of March 1896.
Melkam Genna. A quiet Christmas on the line.
Meskel. The bonfires are lit along the whole front.

meta.motto: Moʼa Anbessa Zeʼimnegede Yihuda — “The Lion of the Tribe of Judah has conquered.”
